text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Government and workers' union to start negotiations over salary hike next week.
- The government shelves a draft family law which will be debated and adopted by the upcoming elected parliament.
- The government reports a $4.3 billion balance trade surplus in 1996.
- Algeria's soccer officials elect the football national federation chief on Thursday.
